observations.command_note: The recorded command is the command that runs, and the command to repeat this comparison with. The 2026-08-03 run used the same arguments without --draw-adjudication, which enabled adjudication implicitly; adjudication is now off unless asked for, so the enabling flag is required and the record carries it. Never drop the draw parameters to make the command parse: the deliberately early draw rule is what makes all eight games draw and gives the three runners one outcome to compare, and without it the games play out and the comparison is against different conditions, which reads as a parity divergence that is not one.
observations.command_proof: Run as recorded for the release acceptance repeat: exit 4, inconclusive, 8 games, 0/8/0, 4 complete pairs, pentanomial [0, 0, 4, 0, 0], 0 faults. The pre-Phase-10(b) form, without --draw-adjudication, exits 2 with a usage error naming the flag.

divergences.reason: The external fixed runs complete normally; the capped Colosseum SPRT correctly reports INCONCLUSIVE with exit 4 at four zero-variance pairs.
FastChess/Cute Chess display NaN or infinity while Colosseum retains typed unavailability; no finite statistic exists to compare.
